title: AWKUM Advertisement No. 70 (2026): Faculty Vacancy Announced for Assistant Professor (BPS-19) in Food Science and Technology
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

FACULTY REQUIRED

ADVERTISEMENT NO. 70 (2026)

Faculty Required — Assistant Professor BPS-19

In pursuit of its mission to empower a diverse community of learners
through quality education, impactful research, innovation, and
collaboration,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

invites applications from Pakistani nationals for appointment on

Regular Basis
as per the details provided below.

Faculty Position

Position | Discipline / Subject | No. of Posts | Eligibility Criteria
Assistant Professor BPS-19 | Food Science and Technology | 01 | PhD in the relevant field from an
HEC recognized University / Institute.

Maximum Age Limit

40 Years

Last Date

October 30, 2026

Processing Fee

Rs. 2,000/-

💳 APPLICATION PROCESSING FEE — BANK DETAILS

NON-REFUNDABLE APPLICATION PROCESSING FEE:

Rs. 2,000/-

Bank

Bank of Khyber, Mardan

Account Number

00792005876772

IBAN

PK40KHYB0079002005876772

Amount

Rs. 2,000/-

Required Action

Deposit the fee through e-challan and upload a copy
of the deposited challan on the University job portal.

Online Application

Applicants shall apply only through the official AWKUM
online job portal. Applications submitted through any
other mode shall not be accepted.

🌐 APPLY ONLINE — JOB PORTAL (http://jobs.awkum.edu.pk)

🌐 Downnload Complete Advertisement (https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1H5Oa5XxljX0pe2EpmzKM1GjgKr3d1w9S)

Last Date to Apply: October 30, 2026

Terms & Conditions

Applicants shall apply only through the online job portal
available at
http://jobs.awkum.edu.pk

on or before
October 30, 2026
.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.

It shall be the sole responsibility of the applicants to ensure
that they have filled in all the required fields of the online
application form and uploaded all relevant documents. No column
of the application form shall be left blank. Postal address,
landline/mobile numbers, and a valid email address must be clearly mentioned.

All information and documents must be submitted by the closing date.
No additional claim, record, or document shall be entertained at
any subsequent stage.

All fresh appointments shall be made under the Contributory
Provident Fund (CP Fund) policy of the Government of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa, except those who are already serving against a
pensionable BPS post and were eligible for pension in their
previous regular service.

Applicants serving in Government, Semi-Government, and Autonomous
Bodies shall apply through proper channel and submit a
No Objection Certificate (NOC)/permission from their parent organization.

The upper age limit may be relaxed, upon request of the applicant,
on a case-to-case basis in accordance with the University’s
applicable Age Relaxation Rules.

Any notification/clarification of Higher Education Commission,
Islamabad adopted through prescribed procedure shall be applicable
on the advertisement.

Applicants are strictly advised to upload only valid and authentic
documents. Any document found ambiguous, fake, or forged shall
lead to rejection of the application and may also entail legal action.
Furthermore, any deficiency/concealment/misrepresentation of facts
by any candidate at any stage will lead to disqualification.

Applicants holding foreign degrees/certificates must provide an
Equivalency Certificate from the Higher Education Commission
(HEC)/Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC), Islamabad,
before the closing date.

Degrees, diplomas, or certificates in languages other than English
must be accompanied by an officially verified English translation,
duly submitted before the closing date.

Applicants shall submit an official percentage certificate issued
by the Controller of Examinations or the relevant issuing authority
of the awarding University/Institution, where transcripts/DMCs do
not explicitly mention percentage marks.

In the case of semester system, a CGPA of

3.00/4.00
shall be considered equivalent to
First Division.

Experience shall be counted only if supported by an Experience
Certificate duly issued by the HR/Establishment Section or
equivalent department/section of the concerned University/Institution.

Distinction marks shall be awarded only upon the provision of an
authentic certificate/document issued by the Controller of
Examinations or equivalent issuing authority of the concerned
University/Institution.

In the case of research publications, applicants must provide
complete bibliographic details including the title of the paper,
author(s), name of journal, ISSN number, volume number, and date
of publication. Only those publications shall be considered which
are recognized by the Higher Education Commission (HEC), Islamabad.
Publications with incomplete or ambiguous details shall not be accepted.

In case of Research projects, applicants must provide valid award
letter as Principal Investigator, duly certified by the Competent Authority.

A non-refundable application processing fee of

Rs. 2,000/-
shall be deposited through e-challan
in University account
Bank of Khyber, Mardan
.
A copy of the deposited challan must be uploaded on the job portal.

Authentic copies of all academic transcripts, degrees, certificates,
experience certificates, CNIC, research papers/publications, and
a recent passport-size photograph must be uploaded with the application.
Original documents will be required at the time of interview.

Eligibility in all respects shall be determined strictly as of
the closing date of the advertisement.

Only eligible shortlisted applicants shall be called for interview.

The selected applicants shall be governed by the Statutes, Rules,
Regulations, and policies of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
as amended from time to time.

The University reserves the right to withhold the appointment
against any advertised post, or reject any/all applications
without assigning any reason.

For updates regarding eligibility/ineligibility lists and other
relevant information, applicants are advised to regularly visit
the University website
www.awkum.edu.pk
.

No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the interview.

Note:

Errors and omissions, if any, are subject to rectification by the University.
